blindSummary: Trans visitors here face serious danger. Same-sex conduct is legal, but the state has effectively collapsed: armed gangs control most of the capital, the police are outgunned, and mob violence against people perceived to be LGBT is documented. There is no legal gender recognition, no protection infrastructure, and no functioning judiciary. The trans-specific risk is inseparable from the generalised collapse - being outed in gang-controlled territory can be lethal.
blindOutOfScope: State collapse is general; mob violence against LGBT people documented.
